summary.name: SeedanceCheap
summary.one_liner: SeedanceCheap is a pay-per-credit AI video studio built around the Seedance 2.5 model, with reference-based video remixing, image tools, voice, and a short-drama builder.
use_cases: generate short AI videos from a prompt or reference
swap a character, product or outfit into a reference video
create a short drama series with recurring characters
add a voiceover to a portrait
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web studio for generating AI video with the Seedance 2.5 model. Users pick a reference performance from a library or upload an MP4, add a character or object photo, optionally add a prompt, and choose a phone, landscape or square frame and quality. A 30-second 480p video is listed at 0.5 credit, or $0.495 per request from a $99 upfront pack of 100 credits. The site also offers a Genjutsu restyle feature, image enlargement and background removal, music and voice tools, video restoration, and a multi-step short-drama builder. Downloads are available for 48 hours after delivery, and private saved references are kept for 30 days.
notable: Seedance 2.5 video at 480p for 0.5 credit per 30-second request, with no subscription
Reference-based remix: swap characters, products or outfits into a source video
Page lists approximate per-second rates from fal for Seedance 2.5 and Kling 3 for comparison
Credits are restored automatically if generation fails
caveats: Generation requires buying a $99 upfront pack of 100 credits; no free tier is stated
Reference guidance means exact movement and identity can vary
Page notes that the supplier transport is simulated in this staging view and no paid generation is sent; provider identity and output equivalence still need verification
